text:
내가 추구하는 삶이
딴 사람들이 잘 이해하지 못하면
en: If others don't quite get the life you're after,

text:
또 너무 *또라이* 같이
막 이렇게 혼자 막 가는 거면
en: Though if you're charging off alone like a weirdo,

text:
많은 사람이 가는 생각
많은 사람이 하는 생각
en: The way most people go, what most people think,
if you live thinking just like them,

text:
내가 *바르게* 가고 있는지를
생각해 봐야 돼요
en: ask yourself if you're on the right road.

text:
많은 사람들이 추구하는
삶의 핵심은 뭡니까?
en: What's at the heart of the life most people chase?
And by happiness they mean comfort.
Don't pray for an easy life.
Grace isn't a tool for comfort. It's a tool for mission.
